_note: Everything a member changes lives here. Times are SOURCE seconds in segments (the numbers below are example values: Claude sets them per take at real pauses); every other moment is a spoken phrase (matched in assets/words-cut.json), so the look re-times itself to a new take. Run cut.py, then build.py.
_segments_note: One object per take. src = your SDR take; keep = [start, end] spans in source seconds; shift_px slides the take down (120-240) only if a card needs the room above your head; grade is optional warmth etc. Add another object for a second take.
_word_fixes_note: Words whisper mishears in YOUR take, e.g. {"Kanva": "Canva"}. Phrase keys work across words.
_hook_note: 2 lines, 5-9 words, one emoji at most (never a rocket). until = the first word you say AFTER your spoken hook.
_cta_note: Optional. Only for a call to action you really say on camera (e.g. a comment keyword, only if you have a real keyword funnel set up). from / until = spoken phrases. Delete this block if there's no CTA.
_cards_note: One card only for a real thing you name: your own screenshot or product page. image lives in assets/cards/. until can be END. No real thing named = no card (delete the entry).
